# model configuration

[Project home](../../../../../README.md) · [Folder guide](../../../../../Documentation/project_structure.md)

Code that defines parameter names, validates their organization and locates project files. To change physical values for a simulation, edit Data/Model_Parameters.

`Simulation_Results/Intact_Walking/Simulation_Code_Used/Code/model_configuration`

| File or folder | Purpose and units |
| --- | --- |
| [__init__.py](__init__.py) | Init. |
| [formulation_constants.py](formulation_constants.py) | Shared constants in the implemented activation, muscle–tendon and contact equations. |
| [numerical_parameters.py](numerical_parameters.py) | Integration and sampling settings, including time steps and numerical tolerances. |
| [parameter_schema.py](parameter_schema.py) | Named physical parameters, their storage locations, units and meanings. |
| [paths.py](paths.py) | Locate the repository independently of drive letter and current folder. |
| [settings.py](settings.py) | Editable applied settings. Original values live in source_snapshots. |
